tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and get result titles, URLs and snippets. Use fetch to read a result.

query.description: What to search the web for.

max_results.description: How many results to return; the setting's max_results caps it.

allowed_domains.description: Only return results from these domains (and their subdomains).

blocked_domains.description: Never return results from these domains.
